A hangover smoothie will not cure a hangover, but ` [Highlight start] blending hydrating liquids, electrolytes, gentle carbs, and protein can ease symptoms like nausea, fatigue, and low blood sugar [Highlight end] `.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXM3CgtKVuyRzm6VWM9UwjRP5U2oLXKy9IRL8EEVWGUtrhvBq9ysYElteQ0KNTtLJuR1Ujsb8Q9edbyb3Vq90s5ozNjrQ2ISW9To8PUguxUBSRpYWr5iJV35tg9Tkxkhe7ruKbB2Jb9itbz3ft)

### Classic Recovery Smoothie

This balanced blend targets dehydration, potassium loss, and an upset stomach:[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXQAN5DD_xhpzz071q5aFHhQ5biUYcvT0wfp7AwXoKX2z9Sp9fPNlE-0Y6e12F4uL84yNBrusyO1elJ99EC2wOAzLJA7tVXc23ng5sZiWdCRwBjq9XCDnlGqT0nSFLiB9RjNCnmnchktlGArBY7l7wO4w)

- **Base:** Coconut water (for electrolytes) and unsweetened almond or oat milk
- **Fruit:** 1 banana (for potassium and gentle carbs) plus blueberries or pineapple
- **Nausea relief:** Fresh ginger (about 1/2 tbsp grated or sliced)
- **Sustained energy:** Rolled oats or Greek yogurt/protein powder to stabilize blood sugar[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXM3CgtKVuyRzm6VWM9UwjRP5U2oLXKy9IRL8EEVWGUtrhvBq9ysYElteQ0KNTtLJuR1Ujsb8Q9edbyb3Vq90s5ozNjrQ2ISW9To8PUguxUBSRpYWr5iJV35tg9Tkxkhe7ruKbB2Jb9itbz3ft)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXQAN5DD_xhpzz071q5aFHhQ5biUYcvT0wfp7AwXoKX2z9Sp9fPNlE-0Y6e12F4uL84yNBrusyO1elJ99EC2wOAzLJA7tVXc23ng5sZiWdCRwBjq9XCDnlGqT0nSFLiB9RjNCnmnchktlGArBY7l7wO4w)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXTzBlu_eSQ8LFze2nKVtLiKJAOSICvBEfp0Dp1qZul_VPilr0yf4C_qzJIFzuO8grNTN_kUR2ZLmP6wqqGQB4AQB7_M25glQkHCytU2jJ4PniWPZrRfZ0TE0h3vQRVwZlHGyYuVt8PQ)

Blend all ingredients until smooth and drink cold. You can find a full breakdown of this style in the [nutribullet](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXQAN5DD_xhpzz071q5aFHhQ5biUYcvT0wfp7AwXoKX2z9Sp9fPNlE-0Y6e12F4uL84yNBrusyO1elJ99EC2wOAzLJA7tVXc23ng5sZiWdCRwBjq9XCDnlGqT0nSFLiB9RjNCnmnchktlGArBY7l7wO4w) recipe or read nutritionist tips on [Healthline](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXM3CgtKVuyRzm6VWM9UwjRP5U2oLXKy9IRL8EEVWGUtrhvBq9ysYElteQ0KNTtLJuR1Ujsb8Q9edbyb3Vq90s5ozNjrQ2ISW9To8PUguxUBSRpYWr5iJV35tg9Tkxkhe7ruKbB2Jb9itbz3ft).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXTzBlu_eSQ8LFze2nKVtLiKJAOSICvBEfp0Dp1qZul_VPilr0yf4C_qzJIFzuO8grNTN_kUR2ZLmP6wqqGQB4AQB7_M25glQkHCytU2jJ4PniWPZrRfZ0TE0h3vQRVwZlHGyYuVt8PQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXQAN5DD_xhpzz071q5aFHhQ5biUYcvT0wfp7AwXoKX2z9Sp9fPNlE-0Y6e12F4uL84yNBrusyO1elJ99EC2wOAzLJA7tVXc23ng5sZiWdCRwBjq9XCDnlGqT0nSFLiB9RjNCnmnchktlGArBY7l7wO4w)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXM3CgtKVuyRzm6VWM9UwjRP5U2oLXKy9IRL8EEVWGUtrhvBq9ysYElteQ0KNTtLJuR1Ujsb8Q9edbyb3Vq90s5ozNjrQ2ISW9To8PUguxUBSRpYWr5iJV35tg9Tkxkhe7ruKbB2Jb9itbz3ft)

### Different Variations
Depending on how your stomach feels, different styles focus on different needs:[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXX1lwSEXQjnvfpVZp5OdptQazbBYwmN8VD_Y3tOZBl1zaE_SBr-IeK0p2OIVgVoGhCJwa8NTCCoSCfYMuBfDe7r1FdQZ8S5gwuZ7JZnOqNstun24rz22jQ55GTuxY2Qn0NBs_HiYAMzxQbAXGCRTp8FwowEgLK95hJ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXM3CgtKVuyRzm6VWM9UwjRP5U2oLXKy9IRL8EEVWGUtrhvBq9ysYElteQ0KNTtLJuR1Ujsb8Q9edbyb3Vq90s5ozNjrQ2ISW9To8PUguxUBSRpYWr5iJV35tg9Tkxkhe7ruKbB2Jb9itbz3ft)

- **Cooling & Light:** Cucumber, green apple, mint, and a squeeze of lemon—good if heavy dairy or rich flavors sound unappealing.
- **Tropical & Soothing:** Pineapple or mango, banana, coconut water, and a splash of lime for vitamin C and easy hydration.
- **Protein-Rich:** Banana, protein powder or Greek yogurt, nut butter, and milk to keep you full longer.
- **Store-Bought Options:** Smoothie chains often carry dedicated recovery blends, such as The Hangover Smoothie at [Keva](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXR7_beAg03ufTZAswsLB9IFY6YTI3VIk54-46jbT0Q3eKtzzDrXVjHtEF_URHdPUQ0WQKD3PErBYbI3SNZ6xOA4JWR6EyuUoJTgvoTJJ4Ui8kvToVSFlyP9fh9bOJv2UJHJ1InxP3khmqBMm4) or the Hangover Cure Smoothie at Rush Bowls.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXdun3rFxhCfop2egOIHKIwhjBQg3P68T081h4yU89NnLwPf1HDzgPM-lXvkWYP4j4HVN6967VQBCyf0cCPfRdSpPe9bJucngp86-CFdOY6kDATUV4NIIMU96dBt3RrAz9NEcEuMxPg81fOsXCfd28mzXJbOJyvtd_la4)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXX1lwSEXQjnvfpVZp5OdptQazbBYwmN8VD_Y3tOZBl1zaE_SBr-IeK0p2OIVgVoGhCJwa8NTCCoSCfYMuBfDe7r1FdQZ8S5gwuZ7JZnOqNstun24rz22jQ55GTuxY2Qn0NBs_HiYAMzxQbAXGCRTp8FwowEgLK95hJ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXTzBlu_eSQ8LFze2nKVtLiKJAOSICvBEfp0Dp1qZul_VPilr0yf4C_qzJIFzuO8grNTN_kUR2ZLmP6wqqGQB4AQB7_M25glQkHCytU2jJ4PniWPZrRfZ0TE0h3vQRVwZlHGyYuVt8PQ)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXM3CgtKVuyRzm6VWM9UwjRP5U2oLXKy9IRL8EEVWGUtrhvBq9ysYElteQ0KNTtLJuR1Ujsb8Q9edbyb3Vq90s5ozNjrQ2ISW9To8PUguxUBSRpYWr5iJV35tg9Tkxkhe7ruKbB2Jb9itbz3ft)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXR7_beAg03ufTZAswsLB9IFY6YTI3VIk54-46jbT0Q3eKtzzDrXVjHtEF_URHdPUQ0WQKD3PErBYbI3SNZ6xOA4JWR6EyuUoJTgvoTJJ4Ui8kvToVSFlyP9fh9bOJv2UJHJ1InxP3khmqBMm4)

### Quick Tips

- **Skip extra sugar:** Avoid heavy syrups, honey, or overly sugary juices, as excess sugar can worsen dehydration.
- **Pair with water:** Drink plain water alongside your smoothie to rehydrate steadily.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXM3CgtKVuyRzm6VWM9UwjRP5U2oLXKy9IRL8EEVWGUtrhvBq9ysYElteQ0KNTtLJuR1Ujsb8Q9edbyb3Vq90s5ozNjrQ2ISW9To8PUguxUBSRpYWr5iJV35tg9Tkxkhe7ruKbB2Jb9itbz3ft)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXTzBlu_eSQ8LFze2nKVtLiKJAOSICvBEfp0Dp1qZul_VPilr0yf4C_qzJIFzuO8grNTN_kUR2ZLmP6wqqGQB4AQB7_M25glQkHCytU2jJ4PniWPZrRfZ0TE0h3vQRVwZlHGyYuVt8PQ)
